Text: Actions are judged by intentions.
None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
A strong believer is better than a weak believer.
Knowledge enlivens the soul.
Raise your words, not your voice. It is rain that grows flowers, not thunder.
The best charity is that given in Ramadan.
The heart of the believer is the throne of mercy.
Avoid jealousy, for it destroys good deeds as fire destroys wood.
Patience is to faith as the head is to the body.
Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.
By Allah, Allah will never disgrace you. You maintain family ties and help the needy.
Cleanliness is half of faith.
Account yourself before you are accounted.
The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.
Education is the passport to the future.
The best of you are those who are best to their wives.
Do good deeds properly, sincerely, and moderately.
Allah is gentle and loves gentleness.
The knowledge of anything is a consequence of the knowledge of God.
Seek knowledge from the cradle to the grave.
Victory is changing the hearts of your opponents, not slaughter.
The believer is not bitten from the same hole twice.
Allah is my sufficiency, and He is the best disposer of affairs.
The best jihad is a word of truth before a tyrant ruler.
This world is a bridge; cross it, but do not build upon it.
Whoever treads a path seeking knowledge, Allah will ease his way to Paradise.
Modesty is a part of faith.
The signs of a hypocrite are three: lying, breaking promises, and betraying trust.
He who finds a new path is a pathfinder, even if the trail is old.
The cure for ignorance is to ask questions.
I am a man who, when oppressed, seeks justice.
Do not waste water, even if you are at a flowing river.
O Allah, if I worship You for fear of Hell, burn me in Hell.
The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand others are safe.
Be aware of your own worth; use all of your power to achieve it.
The best among you are those with the best character.
The whole world is imagination. Truth is but the Creator.
The strong is not the one who overcomes people, but the one who controls himself while angry.
Knowledge is the key to wealth and power.
Take advantage of five before five: youth before old age, health before sickness, wealth before poverty, free time before busyness, and life before death.
If you fear nothing but Allah, you will hate nothing but falsehood.
Allah does not look at your appearances or wealth, but at your hearts and deeds.
The greatest happiness is the happiness of the soul.
A man’s true wealth is the good he does in this world.
Patience in battle is better than strength.
The ink of the scholar is holier than the blood of the martyr.
Ignorance is the enemy of justice.
The best of you are those who feed others and return greetings.
Your heart is a mirror; polish it with remembrance of Allah.
Help your brother, whether he is the oppressor or the oppressed.
Without justice, there can be no lasting power.
The best of people are those who bring most benefit to others.
One child, one teacher, one book can change the world.
The most perfect believer is the best in character.
Travel leaves you speechless, then turns you into a storyteller.
A good word is charity.
Burn the boats. There is no retreat.
Do not be angry.
Knowledge without action is vanity.
The believer’s shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charity.
Unity, faith, and discipline.
Allah is Kind and loves kindness.
A mother’s lap is the first school.
The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
You cannot be a revolutionary without a sense of justice.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest.
Act as if you will die tomorrow, and work as if you will live forever.
Even a smile is charity.
The East can only be reformed by the East.
None of you should wish for death because of a calamity.
There are 360 degrees. Why stick to one?
The most beloved deed to Allah is consistency, even if small.
Islam is not a religion in the conventional sense.
The greatest struggle is against one’s own desires.
Human rights are universal, no matter the culture.
The best of you is the one who is best to his family.
What is simpler than simplicity? What is more complex than complexity?
Allah is Beautiful and loves beauty.
Education is the light of the soul.
The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful.
A crown does not make a king.
Speak good or remain silent.
The heart is a vessel; fill it with what matters most.
The worst thing to fill one’s stomach with is wealth.
A woman’s strength is in her wisdom.
Whoever covers the faults of a Muslim, Allah will cover his faults on Judgment Day.
Science is the language of the future.
The best of wealth is a tongue that remembers Allah.
Empty words and long praises do not impress God.
The best of you are those who are slow to anger and quick to calm.
Service to others is the rent you pay for your room here on Earth.
The believer is not a slanderer, curser, or obscene.
To lead is to serve.
The best of you is the one who pays his debts in the best way.
Be thankful for what you have; you’ll end up having more.
The best of you is the one who is best to his neighbors.
Knowledge is a light that guides.
The best prayer after the obligatory ones is the night prayer.
Poverty is unnecessary.
The most beloved of deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if small.
